notizie.titolo: Commission takes new steps to prepare Europeans for growing crisis risks
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 As Europe faces increasingly frequent and complex crises, the European Commission is stepping up efforts to strengthen preparedness across the EU. From helping citizens protect themselves during emergencies to ensuring that national civil protection systems can keep operating when disaster strikes, the EU is delivering concrete measures to make Europe more resilient.

notizie.titolo: Commission conditionally approves JD.com's acquisition of CECONOMY under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 The European Commission has approved, under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation ('FSR'), the acquisition of CECONOMY AG ('CECONOMY') by JD.com, Inc. ('JD.com'). The approval is conditional upon full compliance with the commitments offered by the parties.

notizie.titolo: Il quadro strategico dell'UE per i Rom porta progressi positivi in materia di diritti dei Rom in tutta l'UE e sono necessari ulteriori sforzi
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Comunicato stampa Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 La Commissione europea ha pubblicato la terza relazione di attuazione sul quadro strategico dell'UE per i Rom, che copre il periodo da giugno 2023 a marzo 2025. La relazione individua il modo in cui il quadro contribuisce a far progredire l'uguaglianza, l'inclusione e la partecipazione dei Rom in tutta l'Unione, delineando nel contempo le sfide rimanenti.

notizie.titolo: Joint statement by Executive Vice-President Virkkunen, High Representative Kallas and Commissioner McGrath ahead of the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists
notizie.descrizione: European Commission Statement Brussels, 01 Nov 2026 Violence against journalists undermines the very foundations of open, free and democratic societies. Yet across the world, journalists continue to be killed, tortured, harassed, detained and forced into exile simply for doing their job and holding power to account.
